— only this README is committed. Tests may open them opportunistically and must skip when the
folder is empty. Do not copy, upload or describe their contents in commits, ADRs or logs.

| `boarding_pass.pdf`        | 2     | pdf-lib generated, PDF 1.7, untagged            | Airline boarding pass: barcodes, small text, generated by our own writer library |
| `241109 B-Pass AMB.pdf`    | 1     | unknown producer, PDF 1.7                       | Boarding pass, single page                                                       |
| `220909 Cemair AMB 4D.pdf` | 2     | Edge "print to PDF" (Skia), PDF 1.4, **tagged** | Browser-printed itinerary: tagged structure, web fonts, links                    |
